blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Customs Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza, together with Director Arnold C. Carreon of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), inspected on Friday over 350 kilograms of illegal drugs worth an estimated P661 million.
